import.title: Import
import.intro: Paste your existing list – from OneNote, Word, a text file or Markdown. Indentation becomes categories. Nothing is saved before you've reviewed it.
import.placeholder:
Clothing
  T-shirts
  3x Socks
Toiletries:
- Toothbrush
- Sunscreen
import.example:
• Indentation (spaces or tabs) → nesting
• # Headings → categories
• Lines ending with “:” → categories
• Bullets (-, *, •, ☐, [ ], 1.) are removed
• “3x Socks”, “Socks x3”, “Socks (3)” → quantity
• Packwise JSON exports
import.nothing: Nothing recognised – is the text empty?
import.review_hint: Check the result: untick what you don't want, fix levels with ⇤ ⇥ and switch between 📁 category and • item.

drive.title: By car
drive.collapsed: Show road rules for rental cars and road trips
drive.disclaimer: General rules for cars without a trailer, as of 2026, without guarantee. Signs on the spot always win.
drive.note.de_advisory: Motorways: no general speed limit, 130 km/h recommended. Many sections are limited.
drive.note.rescue_lane: Form an emergency corridor as soon as traffic slows down – not only when you hear sirens.
drive.note.radar_apps: Speed camera apps and radar detectors are banned while driving.
drive.note.at_vest: Hi-vis vest: one for the driver is mandatory, within reach. Wear it after a breakdown outside towns; one per passenger is a good idea.
drive.note.at_igl: Some motorway sections are temporarily limited to 100 km/h for air quality (IG-L) – watch the overhead signs.
drive.note.at_winter: Winter tyres are mandatory in wintry conditions from 1 November to 15 April.
drive.note.ch_radar: Radar detectors are banned, including speed camera alerts in sat navs or apps – switch them off before the border.
drive.note.ch_fines: Fines are very high; clear speeding quickly becomes a criminal offence.
drive.note.lights_day: Lights on during the day too (dipped beam or daytime running lights).
drive.note.it_vest: Hi-vis vest: anyone getting out after a breakdown or accident outside towns must wear one – so take one per person.
drive.note.it_child_alarm: Children under 4 need a child seat with an anti-abandonment alarm in cars registered in Italy – including rental cars. Check when renting. It does not apply to your own foreign-registered car.
drive.note.it_ztl: ZTL zones in almost every old town: do not enter without a permit; cameras send expensive fines – rental cars too. Ask your hotel about access.
drive.note.it_bike_rack: Bike racks: overhanging loads need a red-and-white warning panel (50 × 50 cm, metal).
drive.note.it_lights: Dipped headlights outside towns, also during the day.
drive.note.it_novice: First 3 years after passing the test: motorways 100, expressways 90 km/h.
drive.note.fr_rain: In rain: motorways 110, expressways 100, country roads 70 km/h.
drive.note.fr_rural90: Some country roads allow 90 km/h again – only where signposted.
drive.note.fr_vest: Hi-vis vest within reach inside the car, not in the boot; plus a warning triangle.
drive.note.fr_radar: Radar detectors are banned; sat navs may only show "danger zones".
drive.note.fr_headphones: Headphones and headsets are banned while driving, also for phone calls.
drive.note.fr_novice: Probationary drivers: motorways 110, expressways 100, country roads 80 km/h.
drive.note.es_urban30: In towns 30 km/h on roads with one lane per direction, 20 km/h in shared spaces.
drive.note.es_v16: The V16 warning light replaces the triangle. Only mandatory for Spanish cars – rental cars have one. With your own car the triangle is still fine.
drive.note.es_rear_seat: Children below 135 cm generally ride in the back.
drive.note.es_bike_rack: Bike racks: mark overhanging loads with a red-and-white warning panel.
drive.note.pt_toll: Some motorways only have electronic tolls without booths – register beforehand or ask the rental company for a transponder.
drive.note.nl_motorway: Motorways 100 km/h during the day (6 am–7 pm), up to 130 km/h in the evening and at night where signposted.
drive.note.nl_bikes: Cyclists often have priority; shark teeth on the road mean "give way".
drive.note.nl_milieu: Low-emission zones in many cities, mainly for older diesels.
drive.note.be_rural: Country roads: 70 km/h in Flanders, 90 km/h in Wallonia.
drive.note.be_lez: Low-emission zones in Brussels, Antwerp and Ghent: register foreign cars online beforehand (free).
drive.note.be_right: Priority to the right also applies on bigger roads unless a priority sign says otherwise.
drive.note.dk_signs: Many motorway sections are limited to 110 km/h – watch the signs.
drive.note.nordic_signs: Limits change often and are usually signposted (30–120 km/h).
drive.note.nordic_winter: Winter tyres are mandatory in wintry conditions; watch out for wildlife.
drive.note.no_toll: Tolls and ferries are charged automatically by number plate – register your car with Epass24 beforehand.
drive.note.fi_winter: Motorways are mostly 100 km/h in winter.
drive.note.pl_toll: Electronic tolls (e-TOLL) on some motorways – buy beforehand in the app or online.
drive.note.zero_alcohol: Zero alcohol for everyone – not even a beer with dinner.
drive.note.cz_winter: Winter tyres are mandatory in wintry conditions from 1 November to 31 March.
drive.note.hu_lights: Dipped headlights outside towns, also during the day.
drive.note.si_winter: Winter equipment is mandatory from 15 November to 15 March (winter tyres, or summer tyres with snow chains on board).
drive.note.hr_lights: Lights on during the day from late October to late March.
drive.note.hr_bulbs: Carry a set of spare bulbs (not needed with xenon or LED lights).
drive.note.hr_vest: Wear a hi-vis vest when getting out on the road, so keep it within reach inside the car.
drive.note.gb_london: London: pay the Congestion Charge and ULEZ online – there are no booths.
drive.note.ie_local: Small local roads are mostly 60 km/h.
drive.note.ie_toll: The M50 toll near Dublin has no barrier – pay online by 8 pm the next day.
drive.note.us_state: Speed limits and rules differ from state to state.
drive.note.us_schoolbus: When a school bus stops with flashing lights, traffic in both directions usually has to stop.
drive.note.us_right_on_red: Turning right on red after a full stop is usually allowed (not in New York City).
setup.claim_hero: Packwise now runs with AUTH_MODE=accounts. All your data is still here – it just needs a login.
setup.claim_intro: Pick your existing profile and give it an e-mail address and a password. You become admin.
setup.claim_others: All other profiles are kept and keep access to their households. In the admin area you then give them an e-mail address and send them a link to set their own password.
